title: Build Dashboard UI for API Key Management
description: Create a new dashboard page for users to create, view, and revoke their API keys using shadcn/ui components.
details:
Add `app/dashboard/settings/keys/page.tsx` with:
- Form to create a new key (name input, submit button).
- Table to list existing keys (name, prefix, createdAt, lastUsedAt, revoke action).
- Dialog/modal to display the plaintext key once after creation, with copy-to-clipboard and warning about one-time visibility.
- Confirmation dialog for revoking a key.
Use shadcn/ui components (Card, Button, Table, Dialog) and Tailwind for styling.
test_strategy:
- E2E: Simulate user flow (create, view, copy, revoke key).
- UI: Check accessibility, error/loading states, and one-time key display.
- Integration: Verify UI updates after actions.

title: Integrate API Key UI with Backend and State Management
description: Connect the dashboard UI to the backend API using a data fetching library for real-time updates and error handling.
details: Use SWR or React Query to fetch, create, and revoke keys from the API. Ensure optimistic updates, loading and error states, and automatic refetching after mutations. Handle authentication context to ensure only the logged-in user’s keys are displayed and managed.
test_strategy:
- Integration: Test API/UI sync for all operations.
- E2E: Simulate network errors and verify UI resilience.
- Security: Ensure no key data leaks between users.

title: Update Dashboard Navigation to Include API Key Management
description: Add a navigation link to the new API key management page in the dashboard sidebar or settings menu.
details: Modify `components/ui/sidebar.tsx` or `app/dashboard/layout.tsx` to include a link to `/dashboard/settings/keys`. Ensure the link is visible only to authenticated users and follows existing navigation patterns.
test_strategy:
- UI: Verify link visibility and navigation.
- Integration: Confirm access control (only logged-in users).
- Usability: Check for consistent placement and styling.

title: Design and Implement API Keys Database Schema
description: Create a new Drizzle ORM schema and migration for the `api_keys` table to securely store user API keys and related metadata.
details: Define a new table `api_keys` in `lib/db/schema/apiKeys.ts` with fields: `id` (UUID, PK), `userId` (FK to users), `name` (string), `keyHash` (hashed API key), `prefix` (string), `scopes` (array or string), `createdAt` (timestamp), `lastUsedAt` (timestamp, nullable). Use Drizzle Kit to generate and apply the migration. Ensure referential integrity and add necessary indexes for performance.
test_strategy:
- Unit: Validate schema types and constraints.
- Integration: Run migration in a test DB and verify table structure.
- Security: Ensure no plaintext keys are stored.

title: Develop Secure API Key Management Endpoints
description: Implement authenticated Next.js API routes for creating, listing, and revoking API keys, ensuring secure key generation and storage.
details:
Create `app/api/keys/route.ts` with handlers for:
- POST: Generate a cryptographically secure key (using Node.js crypto), hash with Argon2 or bcrypt, store hash and metadata, return plaintext key once.
- GET: List metadata for user’s keys (no secret).
- DELETE: Revoke (soft-delete or remove) a key by ID.
All endpoints must require authentication via Better Auth and ensure users can only manage their own keys. Implement input validation with Zod.
test_strategy:
- Unit: Test key generation, hashing, and validation logic.
- Integration: Authenticated requests for create/list/delete; ensure only owner access.
- Security: Attempt unauthorized access and verify rejection.
